subject: Stage-gate acceptance criteria & commercial handoff for on-prem deployment
messages:
From: Tim Hayes <tim.hayes@avacloud.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: AvaCloud Procurement <procurement@avacloud.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: MAP + commercial structure for on-prem pilot

Vanessa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We loved the latency results, and the on-prem option is a hard requirement for our financial services customers. Our procurement team asked for a mutual action plan (MAP) tied to commercial milestones so we can align legal/finance with engineering. Key asks:

- Clear stage-gate criteria for pilot -> prod (eval acceptance tests, data residency checks)
- Pricing model during pilot and production (including any platform fees)
- Commit/ramp schedule that triggers discounts or reserved capacity pricing
- SOC2 evidence and expected delivery timeline

Can you send a MAP we can attach to our purchase order and a short commercial summary for our CFO? Procurement would like to know if platform fees can be amortized across committed months versus an upfront invoice.

Best,
Tim
Tim Hayes
Head of Infrastructure Programs
AvaCloud
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Tim Hayes <tim.hayes@avacloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP + commercial structure for on-prem pilot

Hi Tim —

Great to hear. Attached is a draft MAP (AVA_MAP_v3.xlsx) and a two-page commercial summary that maps pricing to stage gates. High-level bullets:

- Pilot (8 weeks): development + acceptance; flat per-instance license at $2,500/month per instance; platform fee waived for pilot.
- Ramp (months 3–6): volume-based discount starts at 10% once committed instances hit 20; trial to reserved conversion available.
- Production (month 6+): reserved capacity pricing with platform fee of $55,000/yr or an amortized option at $4,583/month for 12 months.
- Security: we attached SOC2 evidence request checklist; Redwood can provide the SOC2 kit within 3 business days and additional logs on a 30-day SLA.

Quick ask: can procurement confirm whether an amortized platform fee is acceptable to finance? If not, we can propose a hybrid (partial upfront + monthly).

Looping in Marissa (AE) to help with the CFO side and Karthik for on-prem SOW details.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: MAP + commercial structure for on-prem pilot

Vanessa / Karthik —

Quick internal notes before we send final to AvaCloud:

- Platform fee: Finance prefers invoice on PO vs amortization; if they insist on amortization, we need CTC sign-off (legal + revenue recognition). Suggest offering amortized option only for multi-year commits (>=24 months).
- Discounts: recommend a staircase schedule in the MAP: 10% at 20 instances, 18% at 50, 25% at 100; tie each level to a commit date and audit window.
- SOC2: we can provide SOC2 kit + SOC attestation PDF; engineering can deliver audit logs and KV cache retention policy within 7 business days.
- Add a cancel/fallback clause in the MAP: 30-day notice with data export assistance and a one-time portability fee.

Karthik — can you draft an SOW appendix that clarifies on-prem install windows, test harness for acceptance criteria, and the support SLAs that trigger ramp discounts? If you can attach a one-page SOW stub, I will include it in the MAP package.

-Marissa

On Sat, Sep 12, 2026 at 09:15 Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com> wrote: (original below)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: MAP + commercial structure for on-prem pilot

Thanks — attaching Draft_SOW_onprem_v1.docx with the technical acceptance criteria and the ramp-trigger logic. Highlights:

- Acceptance tests: sample set (latency p95 < 200ms for 95% of requests at pilot scale; prefix cache hit-rate > 60% on synthetic workload).
- Pilot deliverables: install window, one knowledge-transfer session, security review checklist completion.
- Ramp triggers: automatic discount kick-in after verified instance count and two-week stability window; discounts applied starting on first full month after threshold pass.
- Platform fee handling: we can support (A) upfront platform fee on PO, (B) amortized monthly over committed months (requires revenue-team sign-off), or (C) convert to per-instance surcharge during pilot only.

I'll include the SOW appendix and the standard support SLA. If finance wants amortization, we need a signed commitment period in the MAP (>= 12 months) and an invoice schedule.

—Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
From: Tim Hayes <tim.hayes@avacloud.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage-gate acceptance criteria & commercial handoff for on-prem deployment

Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the SOW. Procurement reviewed and proposed the following changes:

1) Platform fee: prefer amortization option spread over first 12 months rather than one-time upfront. This is a hard ask from finance; if Redwood requires upfront, we will need to escalate.
2) Discount cadence: Accept staircase but request earlier ramp milestone: 10% at 15 instances (not 20) given our anticipated burst in Q1.
3) SOC2 evidence: please provide the SOC2 attestation PDF and the audit log access instructions by EOD Thursday.

Next steps from our side: procurement will sign the MAP (with our redlines) and return a PO if we can get a DocuSign-ready SOW and the amortization schedule formalized. Can you send a DocuSign link for the SOW + MAP once you incorporate the 15-instance breakpoint and amortized platform fee?

We should aim for legal + finance approval by 30 Sep to start the pilot in October.

Regards,
Tim Hayes
Head of Infrastructure Programs
AvaCloud

Attachments: procurement_form_signed.pdf
